tool_schemas.name: weather
tool_schemas.description: Resolves a normalized location from either `q` (optionally disambiguated by `country_code`) or the `latitude`/`longitude` pair, then returns the current weather snapshot in the requested `units`, optionally including the upstream provider payload when `include_raw` is true; the request is recorded for audit and quota enforcement and may be served from cache unless `force_refresh` is set. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `api_key` does not match the required format, if neither `q` nor both `latitude` and `longitude` are provided, if coordinates are out of range, if `country_code` is not exactly 2 letters, or if `units` is not one of the supported values. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the API key is missing or not recognized, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client has exhausted its allowed calls, NOT_FOUND when the location cannot be resolved to a known normalized location, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when a fresh fetch is required (by `force_refresh` or cache miss/expiry) but the upstream provider request fails.

api_key.description: API key id used to authenticate the request (wthr_key_01H...).

q.description: Location query string (e.g., city name, postal code) used to resolve a normalized location.

latitude.description: Latitude for location lookup if not using q.

longitude.description: Longitude for location lookup if not using q.

country_code.description: Optional 2-letter ISO country code to disambiguate q (e.g., US).

units.description: Units system for returned values; affects temperature/wind display.

force_refresh.description: If true, bypass cache and fetch fresh data from the upstream provider.

include_raw.description: If true, include the provider raw payload in the response.

tool_schemas.name: me
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity resolved from `api_key`, including the owning api_client, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit counters; refuses when the key is missing, unknown, or revoked.

api_key.description: API key id used to authenticate the request (wthr_key_01H...).

tool_schemas.name: api_clients_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists API clients visible to the caller, optionally filtered by status/plan/name; returns a paginated result set and refuses invalid filters.

api_key.description: API key id used to authenticate the request (wthr_key_01H...).

name_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring match on client name.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: api_clients_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on an API client and/or performs lifecycle transitions via `status`; refuses unknown client ids, invalid status transitions, or attempts to modify restricted fields.

api_key.description: API key id used to authenticate the request (wthr_key_01H...).

plan.description: Client plan used for quota policy.

monthly_request_quota.description: Monthly request quota for non-enterprise clients.

reset_at.description: Timestamp when the monthly quota window resets.

status.description: Lifecycle transition for the client; must follow allowed transitions.

tool_schemas.name: api_keys_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new API key for an existing API client and returns the plaintext key only at creation time along with key metadata; refuses if the client does not exist or is not active.

api_key.description: API key id used to authenticate the request (wthr_key_01H...).

client_id.description: api_clients.id that will own the new key.

label.description: Optional display label for the key (e.g., 'prod-server').

tool_schemas.name: api_keys_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates an API key lifecycle state (e.g., revoke) for a given key id; refuses invalid transitions or unknown keys.

api_key.description: API key id used to authenticate the request (wthr_key_01H...).

status.description: Lifecycle transition for the key; only active -> revoked is permitted.

tool_schemas.name: weather_requests_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists recorded weather requests for audit and troubleshooting, optionally filtered by time window, status, client, key, or location; returns a paginated result set and refuses invalid filters.

api_key.description: API key id used to authenticate the request (wthr_key_01H...).

created_at_gte.description: Return requests created at or after this timestamp.

created_at_lt.description: Return requests created before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.
